title: DreamCo Universal Task Mastery
authoring_policy: Original DreamCo explanations, examples, labs, rubrics and assessments; third-party resources are cited as references and are not copied.

modules.title: Task Understanding and Decomposition
modules.assessment: Decompose an unfamiliar outcome into testable deliverables and identify unknowns.

modules.title: Research, Sources and Data Rights
modules.assessment: Build a provenance ledger and correctly separate owned, licensed, reference-only and blocked assets.

modules.title: Build and Debug Software
modules.assessment: Deliver a tested change with failure reproduction, minimal fix and regression coverage.

modules.title: Data Analysis and Model Evaluation
modules.assessment: Create a reproducible analysis and evaluation report with leakage and uncertainty checks.

modules.title: Cloud Operations and Safe Recovery
modules.assessment: Recover from a simulated incident and verify service and data integrity.

modules.title: Professional and Real-World Task Performance
modules.assessment: Complete a source-grounded, role-relevant task while respecting professional and safety boundaries.
